prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input: Image1 is the COMPLETE original Silent Storm opaque equipment diffuse atlas enlarged exactly8x nearest-neighbor solely to reveal original coordinates. It is the edit target.
Request: Faithful HD material reconstruction, same SQUARE1:1 complete flat opaque UV canvas.
Source inventory: Square extremely dark plain black-gray cloth cap diffuse atlas. Preserve broad dark crescent-like lower cloth field with large original black cutout at lower-left, original narrow curved shaded band across upper-middle, and upper-left dark rectangular strip containing exactly ONE original tiny short pale vertical glint. Keep that glint a flat mark; never infer a buckle/prong/hole. Preserve source faint angular shade contour around it without adding hardware. All soft cloth shading/dark background/layout must stay original. No new seam outlines or pale piping.
Exact UV/edge lock: Preserve every original island, black gap, color field, clipped shape, outline, reflection, mark and baked shading at identical normalized coordinates/count/shape/pitch. ORIGINAL EDGE-TOUCHING elements MUST continue to touch their original canvas edges. Never add top/bottom black margins, gray header panels, padding, letterbox, cropping, recentering, complete an edge-clipped piece or move the inlet down. Whole canvas only; no bbox/packing/zoom/scene. Preserve the original exposure distribution and soft reflections; don't convert shaded fields/glints into new geometric hardware.
Material: Fine subtle irregular plain source material texture only at source scale. No repeating curls/ornament, coarse weave, hatch, damage, wrinkles, stitches, new rims/piping or scratches. Cloth remains cloth; steel/brass/plastic stays its source material. Keep blank and solid color areas plain; no invented noise there. Coarse original pixel blocks are sampling/compression, not new seams. Later brightness matched numerically.
Avoid: Any added hardware, rivets, holes, prongs, buckles, parts, symbols, letters, objects or redesign. Exact original content/count/phase, whole UV geometry including canvas edges and plain material identity have priority.
reference_recipe: Exact original entire canvas8x nearest sourceguide; no crop/padding/bbox/artistic edits. Raw entire-canvas normalized to logical4x Lanczos only, source alpha/numeric brightness handled by root.
